description: One case by number: its status, filing date, employer and, once decided, DOL's record. Covers PERM, prevailing wage, H-1B LCA and H-2A, H-2B and CW-1 (applications, job orders and wage requests). A seasonal case adds its workers, work period and worksite, and the job as DOL accepted it. A pending PERM case adds its filing month's place in the queue. Example: {"caseNumber":"G-100-26045-123456"}.

caseNumber.description: As DOL prints it: G-100-... for PERM, P-100-... for a prevailing wage request, I-200-... for an H-1B LCA, H-300-..., H-400-..., JO-A-300-... or C-500-... for the seasonal programs. Example: G-100-26045-123456.

name: get_case

asOf.description: The date the data is true for, YYYY-MM-DD, when one applies.

anyOf.description: One DOL case: its status, dates, employer and job, DOL's decided record once there is one, and for a pending PERM case its place in the queue.

accepted.description: H-2A and H-2B only: the job as DOL accepted it (wage, workers, work period, worksite), before any decision.

caseNumber.description: The case number as DOL prints it, e.g. G-100-26045-123456.

decision.description: DOL's decided record, once a disclosure file carries the case: status, receivedDate, decisionDate, and by program the occupation, worksite, wage and law firm. Null while the case is pending.

employer.description: The employer's name as DOL holds it.

anyOf.description: The day the case was filed, as YYYY-MM-DD.

isFinal.description: True once DOL has decided the case or the employer withdrew it.

jobTitle.description: The job title on the case.

program.description: Which DOL program the case belongs to: perm (PERM labor certification), pwd (prevailing wage request), lca (H-1B labor condition application) or seasonal (H-2A, H-2B or CW-1).

programName.description: The program in words, e.g. PERM labor certification.

anyOf.description: PERM only: where the case's filing month stands in DOL's queue.

casesFiledThatMonth.description: PERM cases filed in that month.

decidedFromThatMonth.description: How many of them DOL has decided.

filingMonth.description: The month the case was filed, as YYYY-MM.

pendingFromEarlierMonths.description: Pending PERM cases filed in earlier months, which DOL works first.

pendingFromThatMonth.description: How many of them are still pending.

status.description: DOL's status for the case, as DOL prints it, e.g. ANALYST REVIEW or CERTIFIED. Null when no record carries one.

anyOf.description: The day PERM Tracker last asked DOL about this case, as YYYY-MM-DD.
No such record. Say so; don't retry the same call.

message.description: What wasn't found and what to try, in a sentence.

data.description: The answer, or found: false when no record matched.

page.description: The page on permtracker.app that shows the same thing. Cite it.

title: Get a case by its number
